dex.entry: A small static-furred rodent whose iron-ore-flecked pelt crackles with friction sparks as it scurries through the tunnels. Base form of the Sparkrat line. The classic small cave rodent — but charged.

art.silhouette: Rat-sized, wiry body covered in dark iron-grey fur with tiny amber sparks visible along the spine; prominent rounded ears; long thin tail tipped with an ore nugget.
art.palette: Rat-sized, wiry body covered in dark iron-grey fur with tiny amber sparks visible along the spine; prominent rounded ears; long thin tail tipped with an ore nugget.
art.direction: The classic small cave rodent — but charged. Kids will love the sparking fur.
